bear_assumptions: Apply 20x USD 7.50 normalized forward EPS if industrial and automotive demand fade, internal factory under-utilization pressures margins, inventory risk returns, and Silicon Labs financing raises leverage and the required return.
base_assumptions: Apply 27x USD 9.50 normalized forward EPS as third-quarter guidance converts, broad end-market recovery and 300mm utilization sustain healthy margins, but cyclical growth normalizes and acquisition financing limits balance-sheet protection.
bull_assumptions: Apply 34x USD 11.00 normalized forward EPS if industrial, automotive and data-center demand remain broad, 300mm factory loading compounds margins and cash flow, inventory normalizes, and capacity and Silicon Labs investments earn attractive returns.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence earnings make expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence, and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if broad end-market growth reverses, inventory rises, factory loading compresses margins, free cash flow per share weakens, or Silicon Labs financing materially reduces balance-sheet resilience.
